record.bible_text: Now Hiram<WH02438><WTH8676><WH02361> king<WH04428> of Tyre<WH06865> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> messengers<WH04397> to David<WH01732>, and timber<WH06086> of cedars<WH0730>, with masons<WH07023> and carpenters<WH02796>, to build<WH01129><WTH8800> him an house<WH01004>.

Now these <FI>are<Fi> the names<WH08034> of <FI>his<Fi> children<WH03205><WTH8803> which he had in Jerusalem<WH03389>; Shammua<WH08051>, and Shobab<WH07727>, Nathan<WH05416>, and Solomon<WH08010>,

And the Philistines<WH06430> came<WH0935><WTH8804> and spread<WH06584><WTH8799> themselves in the valley<WH06010> of Rephaim<WH07497>.

And David<WH01732> enquired<WH07592><WTH8799> of God<WH0430>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Shall I go up<WH05927><WTH8799> against the Philistines<WH06430>? and wilt thou deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> them into mine hand<WH03027>? So they came up<WH05927><WTH8799> to Baalperazim<WH01188>; and David<WH01732> smote<WH05221><WTH8686> them there. Then David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, God<WH0430> hath broken in<WH06555><WTH8804> upon mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> by mine hand<WH03027> like the breaking forth<WH06556> of waters<WH04325>: therefore they called<WH07121><WTH8804> the name<WH08034> of that place<WH04725> Baalperazim<WH01188>. <RF>Baalperazim: that is, A place of breaches<Rf>
And when they had left<WH05800><WTH8799> their gods<WH0430> there, David<WH01732> gave a commandment<WH0559><WTH8799>, and they were burned<WH08313><WTH8735> with fire<WH0784>.
And the Philistines<WH06430> yet again<WH03254><WTH8686> spread themselves abroad<WH06584><WTH8799> in the valley<WH06010>.

Therefore David<WH01732> enquired<WH07592><WTH8799> again of God<WH0430>; and God<WH0430> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Go not up<WH05927><WTH8799> after<WH0310> them; turn away<WH05437><WTH8685> from them, and come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon them over against<WH04136> the mulberry trees<WH01057>.

And it shall be, when thou shalt hear<WH08085><WTH8800> a sound<WH06963> of going<WH06807> in the tops<WH07218> of the mulberry trees<WH01057>, <FI>that<Fi> then thou shalt go out<WH03318><WTH8799> to battle<WH04421>: for God<WH0430> is gone forth<WH03318><WTH8804> before<WH06440> thee to smite<WH05221><WTH8687> the host<WH04264> of the Philistines<WH06430>.

David<WH01732> therefore did<WH06213><WTH8799> as God<WH0430> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> him: and they smote<WH05221><WTH8686> the host<WH04264> of the Philistines<WH06430> from Gibeon<WH01391> even to Gazer<WH01507>. <RF>Gibeon: also called, Geba<Rf>
And the fame<WH08034> of David<WH01732> went out<WH03318><WTH8799> into all lands<WH0776>; and the LORD<WH03068> brought<WH05414><WTH8804> the fear<WH06343> of him upon all nations<WH01471>.<CM>
